nodes.title: Source collection
nodes.acceptance: Record primary URLs, retrieval dates, relevant facts and gaps. Distinguish source claims from independently verified facts.

recipe.instructions: Collect the public or authorized sources needed for the goal; retain traceable references.

nodes.title: Evidence and comparison
nodes.acceptance: Each material finding cites its source; assumptions, conflicting evidence and limitations remain visible.

recipe.instructions: Compare the sources against the goal and verify the conclusions that affect the decision.
